name: Brief intent
inclusion: Code each explicit production objective, constraint or deliverable in substantive brief prose.
exclusion_ambiguity: Template headings alone do not qualify; visual intentions are creator-stated, never evaluated.

name: Planned entities
inclusion: Name explicitly planned persistent entities in brief or instructions.
exclusion_ambiguity: Do not reconstruct a narrative from media or assume every mentioned noun is persistent.

name: Scene and shot planning
inclusion: Require explicit scene/shot wording, ordered shot instructions or named folders; retain channel.
exclusion_ambiguity: Folder name shows a label, not executed shot order; multi-shot text is not an enabled parameter.

name: Plan to task
inclusion: Link named plan entity/shot to generation/asset using ID or explicit matching instructions.
exclusion_ambiguity: Name similarity is inferred; document alternate matches and confidence.

name: Build order
inclusion: Require explicit plan or dependency chain supporting a preparation sequence.
exclusion_ambiguity: Timestamp or folder ordering alone is insufficient.

name: Template content
inclusion: Compare individual brief sections with generic placeholder wording, keeping substantive sections separate.
exclusion_ambiguity: A mixed brief is not wholly discarded and a heading does not establish completed planning.

name: Element kind
inclusion: Use disclosed reference category, name and technical instructions; retain literal categories.
exclusion_ambiguity: Names and auto categories are weak semantic evidence; do not merge identities by appearance.

name: Identity and variation
inclusion: Require explicit same-identity/preservation language or named variant relationship.
exclusion_ambiguity: Shared names alone do not establish a version relationship.

name: Reference package
inclusion: Code a disclosed package or instruction to create one; distinguish requested from attached.
exclusion_ambiguity: Do not assess whether the output fulfilled the requested package.

name: Property storage
inclusion: Record the channel containing each specified property and its exact path.
exclusion_ambiguity: Media contents are unobservable; attachment alone does not reveal the properties it carries.

name: Element versions
inclusion: Trace version linkage with IDs and named changed properties.
exclusion_ambiguity: Different outputs or filenames are not automatically versions.

name: Canonical declaration
inclusion: Keep explicit authoritative/canonical declarations separate from measured reuse hubs.
exclusion_ambiguity: Frequency is not approval, canonical status or quality.

name: Text role
inclusion: Use generation_prompts.field_path and prompt_role; crosswalk primary source path without double counting.
exclusion_ambiguity: Nested script and ordinary prompts are different units; absent negative field does not mean no exclusions.

name: Semantic components
inclusion: Label explicit text spans as instructions, preserving task and literal model context.
exclusion_ambiguity: These are intended instructions, not output properties; semantic labels at scale await separate validation.

name: Attached context
inclusion: Pair actual usage rows with prompt tokens on compound keys.
exclusion_ambiguity: A token without an attachment is unresolved; absent usage does not prove text-only.

name: Information location
inclusion: For each property mark observable text/metadata and unknown media contents.
exclusion_ambiguity: No visual inspection; never assign a property to media from attachment presence alone.

name: Prompt structure
inclusion: Code literal structure and operation together; quote just the relevant span.
exclusion_ambiguity: Length is not quality or overload; JSON-shaped text must parse before structured_json.

name: Context conflict
inclusion: Name the conflicting instructions and paths, or the uncertain interpretation.
exclusion_ambiguity: Different channels may refer to different scopes; do not assume model confusion.

name: Image operation
inclusion: Use image job type, input roles, explicit instructions and active parameter values.
exclusion_ambiguity: No recorded input only supports fresh_candidate, never proven text-only; edit request does not prove mask-based editing.

name: Image convergence
inclusion: Multiple actual inputs establish conditioning; explicit producer edges establish staging.
exclusion_ambiguity: Do not call multi-input conditioning compositing layers.

name: Integration instructions
inclusion: Code explicit composition or preservation text and linked inputs.
exclusion_ambiguity: No assessment of correct integration in the result.

name: Editing mechanism
inclusion: Require nonempty mask/layer fields or an explicit boolean value; false is retained.
exclusion_ambiguity: Prompt wording alone never establishes an editing implementation.

name: Still purpose
inclusion: Require explicit purpose in instructions or creator statement; distinguish request and output.
exclusion_ambiguity: Downstream video input is evidence of use as a foundation, not final acceptance.

name: Video route
inclusion: Require typed usage roles, extension settings or explicit shot text; multi-label where needed.
exclusion_ambiguity: Parameter key presence or multi_shots=false does not negate multi-shot prompt wording; no inputs is only text_candidate.

name: Motion instructions
inclusion: Code explicit instruction spans separately for each actor of motion.
exclusion_ambiguity: Do not infer achieved motion or clip quality.

name: Temporal structure
inclusion: Retain stated event order, seconds and cut instructions.
exclusion_ambiguity: Prompt timing is intention; job duration is a separate raw parameter.

name: Audio intent
inclusion: Separate written audio instructions from actual audio jobs and enabled controls.
exclusion_ambiguity: Enabled generate_audio is not evidence of usable sound; external audio may be missing.

name: Invariants
inclusion: Require explicit preserve/do not change instruction and scope.
exclusion_ambiguity: No claim that invariants survived generation.

name: Shot controls
inclusion: Retain literal model/version, raw field path and value, including null and false.
exclusion_ambiguity: Controls across models are not assumed equivalent; missing is distinct from empty.

name: Shot revision
inclusion: Use explicit changed instructions plus linkage where available.
exclusion_ambiguity: A single request establishes intent, not a successful revision chain.

name: Dependency edge
inclusion: Join explicit IDs within film; label unresolved producers and inferred links.
exclusion_ambiguity: Do not infer lineage from chronology, file names or folder proximity.

name: Graph structure
inclusion: Name all edges and graph denominator supporting the structure.
exclusion_ambiguity: Occurrence duplication and raw/preview variants must be audited before counting degree.

name: Asset equivalence
inclusion: Use disclosed identifiers and metadata for raw/preview aliases.
exclusion_ambiguity: URL resemblance alone does not prove identity; preserve unresolved variants.

name: Reuse strategy
inclusion: Require creator declaration or explicit same-asset edges across jobs.
exclusion_ambiguity: High degree alone is neither canonical status nor visual continuity.

name: Downstream review scope
inclusion: Enumerate descendants of a changed input under stated graph completeness.
exclusion_ambiguity: Reachability proposes review scope, never proves which outputs would visually change.

name: Operation role
inclusion: Use explicit instructions, job types and edges; retain observed/creator-stated distinction.
exclusion_ambiguity: Model nickname alone does not establish its role or provider.

name: Literal model
inclusion: Retain model_identifier and source model_name independently.
exclusion_ambiguity: Do not collapse versions or infer providers from product names.

name: Model handoff
inclusion: Require a producer/input edge to establish cross-model transition.
exclusion_ambiguity: Two models in one film are only co-occurrence.

name: Workflow shape
inclusion: Require supported dependency edges and name graph boundaries.
exclusion_ambiguity: No scheduler, routing, agent or autonomous orchestration inference.

name: Audio and finishing visibility
inclusion: Separate audio/edit jobs, external tool statements and folder names.
exclusion_ambiguity: Sound folder is not proof of sound production; missing jobs do not disprove external work.

name: Iteration family
inclusion: Prioritise batch and input evidence; list members and proposed family denominator.
exclusion_ambiguity: Similarity and time alone are provisional; repeated prompts are not independent samples.

name: Iteration mode
inclusion: Distinguish requested correction from a linked observed revision family.
exclusion_ambiguity: No defect, success or failure judgement; a single correction prompt does not prove a prior failed job.

name: Revision delta
inclusion: Compare named family members and record exact changed paths/spans.
exclusion_ambiguity: Do not compare unrelated jobs as revisions merely because dates are near.

name: Downstream adoption
inclusion: Require explicit later input edge for reuse or a distinct approval statement.
exclusion_ambiguity: Reuse is not final acceptance and absence of reuse is not rejection.

name: Organisation
inclusion: Code literal folder labels separately from measured placements/dependencies.
exclusion_ambiguity: Root and Watermarks alone support a flat proxy, not absence of private organisation.

name: Authorship
inclusion: Use author IDs and owner metadata; handoffs need explicit asset edges.
exclusion_ambiguity: Several authors do not establish team structure, labour division or employment.

name: Activity window
inclusion: Use first/last recorded events with timestamp parse coverage.
exclusion_ambiguity: Not labour time, rendering latency, production duration or decision time.

name: Repetition and placement
inclusion: Count distinct entities separately from occurrences; specify denominator.
exclusion_ambiguity: No waste or efficiency claim; cross-film IDs require compound keys.

name: Resource proxy
inclusion: Use recorded generation count / catalogue duration seconds * 60, within stated comparable formats.
exclusion_ambiguity: Not cost, speed or productivity; no model-credit-to-money conversion.
